title: AI Text Detection — signal file (core/01–09)
description: Minimal contract enforced by scripts/validate_corpus.py check C2. A pattern is an observable, documented stylistic/statistical signal — never a verdict rule.

non_native_fp_risk.description: high | medium | not_applicable — honest per-file assessment of false-positive risk on non-native writers (empirical basis: Liang et al. arXiv:2304.02819).

text_length_sensitivity.description: Qualitative reliability vs text length, e.g. low_on_short, robust_on_short.

confidence.description: EDITORIAL PRIOR about signal salience when present. NOT a calibrated probability, NOT P(AI). Never sum, multiply, or threshold as probability (gaps/07).

sources.description: Preferably arXiv IDs like 'arxiv:2412.11385'. Per-pattern sourcing is the corpus's largest open documentation debt — contributions of one sourced pattern each are the most valuable PR type.

estimated_half_life_months.description: Editorial decay estimate (gaps/08), not a measurement.
